decision.reason: Both exact-SHA Synopsys DC runs and all required artifacts are intact, mapped, constraint-clean and numerically consistent. Formality is not blocked by setup margin. The controller has 692.6 ps setup margin and may advance to PrimeTime. The selected slice technically meets the frozen 3.0 ns DC gate by only 0.8 ps under ideal-clock, ZeroWireload, macro-zero assumptions, so an exact 3.0 ns PrimeTime run is useful as a fail-closed diagnostic but cannot promote this point to publication-grade timing. Prefer repairing/balancing the q32 pass-0 combinational path; alternatively report a slower clock and recompute throughput rather than relabeling the current 3 ns point.

descriptor_controller.raw_fatal_substring_classification: Non-fatal VER-104 warning for the source-level initial $fatal inside a FIFO_DEPTH!=8 generate guard; the frozen/default FIFO_DEPTH=8 configuration prunes that guard. This is not a ^Fatal: tool diagnostic.

descriptor_controller.postcompile_check_timing_warning: TIM-216 reset_n has no clock-relative input delay; reset_n is explicitly removed from timed inputs and false-pathed by the frozen SDC.

delay_cell_hold_guard_audit.method: Independently sum every DEL025/050/075/100/150 entry in each postcompile reference report.
delay_cell_hold_guard_audit.inference: The flow mapped with 0.125 ns hold uncertainty and then reported at 0.100 ns; final worst hold slacks are 0.0250/0.0251 ns. Together with the very large DEL populations, this strongly indicates that the M412 areas are conservative hold-guarded diagnostic areas. It does not prove that every DEL cell is guard-induced; a guard-off or physically clocked A/B run is required to measure the guard's causal area overhead.
delay_cell_hold_guard_audit.implication: Removing the guard is not a setup fix. The selected-slice critical path is a long q32 pass-0 comparator/metric cone and should be balanced as an exact distance-plus-lowest-ID tournament or safely pipelined before a robust 3 ns PPA admission.

timing_classification.selected_slice_margin_context: Ideal clock, ZeroWireload, pre-macro, no physical SRAM or routed interconnect.
timing_classification.recommendation: Run exact-M412 Formality now, and an exact-netlist PrimeTime pass may run at 3.0 ns as a fail-closed diagnostic. Do not wait for a pipeline change merely to learn whether PT agrees with the sealed netlist, but do not admit that result as robust 3 ns PPA. For admission, rebalance the exact distance-plus-lowest-ID selection as a tournament or safely pipeline the q32 pass-0 cone and repeat VCS/DC/Formality/PT. If the design instead moves to at least about 3.10 ns, label the lower frequency honestly and recompute throughput; do not keep a 333 MHz claim by merely relaxing the constraint.

findings.title: Selected-slice 3 ns setup closure has only 0.8 ps pre-macro margin
findings.detail: The first max path is input row_original[8] to u_matcher/scratch_pass0_distance_q_reg[4], with 2.8807 ns arrival versus 2.8815 ns required and 111 reported logic levels. This passes the frozen >=0 gate but is not robust enough for a paper PPA point under ideal-clock/ZeroWireload assumptions. Formality is allowed; exact 3 ns PT is diagnostic only until the path is repaired or the clock is honestly slowed.

findings.title: M384 retains bounded synthesis-warning and lint-waiver debt
findings.detail: There are no anchored Error/Fatal diagnostics or forbidden ELAB-312/TIM-209/OPT-150 codes. One VER-104 warning contains the text $fatal in a pruned FIFO_DEPTH!=8 guard, TIM-216 reports reset_n without a clock-relative delay even though it is false-pathed, and postcompile check_design lists 29 feedthrough, 337 shorted-output and 65 constant-output items. These do not create black boxes, latches, loops or constraint violations, but Formality should close their functional risk and a waiver table should accompany any clean-flow claim.

findings.title: The hold-guarded separate-cut areas are conservative diagnostics, not physical accelerator area
findings.detail: The selected slice contains 4,748 DEL cells totaling 8,142.624109 um2 (32.7205% of cell area); the controller contains 1,258 DEL cells totaling 2,195.297969 um2 (28.2786%). Since mapping used 0.125 ns hold uncertainty and final reporting used 0.100 ns, with final hold slacks at 25.0/25.1 ps, the large DEL population is strong evidence of conservative hold padding, though its causal overhead requires an A/B run. The reported 32648.489458 um2 is also only the arithmetic sum of two independent flattened, macro-zero syntheses. Descriptor/PWP SRAMs, memory wires, clock tree, backend compute and routed integration are absent, so no paper-ready area, power, energy or system claim transfers.

findings.title: Cross-cut phase lifecycle remains an external integration obligation
findings.detail: M407 explicitly proved the selected slice has no M384 phase_done input. M412 intentionally synthesizes the modules separately. A future thin integration controller must assert selected-slice phase_release_valid only after M384 completes both replays; M412 does not prove that wiring or its timing.
